findings.title: Loaded delivery state with an empty milestone unbinds active Agency evidence
findings.detail: Agency fallback is limited to a non-loaded delivery report. A valid loaded delivery.json with active_milestone_id empty therefore leaves active_milestone empty and accepts unscoped same-HEAD evidence, despite active Agency state naming a milestone. Fall back to agency_state.current_milestone whenever the loaded delivery state has no usable milestone, and add that case to the tests.
